title: Releasing Cover and Returning Premium on a Travel Protection Policy
content:
A policyholder on the Travel Protection Plans may give up their own cover and take back the premium
returned with it. The policy stands cancelled from the moment the policyholder confirms it, and a returned
premium line is raised on the policy's premium record against an earlier premium line standing on it, so the
net premium paid falls by the amount returned. Cover ends as the policyholder confirms it, and no incident after
that moment is covered.

## When the amount returned is fixed

The premium returned is fixed only after the policy's premium record carries the re-rating owed on every
correction of the certificate's declared particulars.

## The line the return is raised against

The premium returned is raised as one line against the line that carries the base premium of the
certificate, because that is the line the whole premium was rated from, and where the premium
record carries no such line it is raised against the earliest line charged on the policy; a loading
line, the line charged for the issue fee and a line raised to correct another line are never the
line a return is raised against.

## Whose act it is

Giving up cover is the policyholder's own act on their own contract. The desk unlocks the customer-side tool
`release_cover_and_return_premium_07b45938` and hands it over for the customer themselves to run; it is never
performed on the policyholder's behalf.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
|---|---|
| `care_policy_id` | The reference number of the policyholder's own travel protection policy, the cover being given up, read from the policy record |
| `customer_id` | The policyholder's own traveller reference number, read from the traveller profile |
| `source_entry_id` | The reference number of the premium line the return is raised against, read from the premium record of that policy |
| `returned_premium_usd` | The premium returned to the policyholder, given as a positive USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; the line itself carries it as a negative movement of the premium account |

## What comes back

A plain-text confirmation naming the policy now cancelled, the moment the cancellation was confirmed, the
reference number minted for the returned premium line and the amount returned. Receiving that confirmation is
what indicates the cover has been given up and the premium returned; nothing else is returned.
